page.overview:
Who is Miguel Caballero Rojo?

Please note: This name is Spanish; The first or paternal surname is “Caballero” and the second or maternal family name is “Rojo”.

Miguel was born to a conservative Spanish family. Growing up, his wild and unruly nature put him at odds with his family’s expectations, to the extent that Miguel left home aged 15 to live at a bar owned by an acquaintance. The only person he stayed in contact with was his younger sister, who continued to meet with him despite the circumstances. Miguel loved his sister unconditionally, though his adoration and protective impulses went to extremes; for example, when she told him she was engaged to be married, Miguel considered killing her fiancé.

Miguel was unable to attend his sister’s wedding ceremony due to the friction between him and the rest of their family; he watched from outside the church instead. During the wedding, Mishima Zaibatsu planes passed by on a bombing run, destroying the church. Miguel rushed into the ruined building, but his sister was already dead when he found her.

Overcome with grief and anger, Miguel swore vengeance on the Mishima Zaibatsu’s leader, Jin Kazama.
